meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 项目添加本地监控仪表盘:安装依赖、加入推送模块并在启动时调用,之后会定时把会话、用户、Token 用量等数据发给仪表盘,并每 2 秒推送日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 项目增加监控仪表盘或数据看板时触发。

say.text: 请给这个 NanoClaw 项目加上监控仪表盘
say.note: 技能会安装组件并接好启动代码。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 添加 dashboard,并跑构建测试
say.note: 会执行安装、接线和验证步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 的运行日志接到本地看板
say.note: 先添加推送器再重启服务。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: installs the package, copies the pusher into src/, and wires it up at startup so NanoClaw periodically sends runtime data (sessions, users, token usage, etc.) to the dashboard and pushes logs every 2 seconds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard or data viewer to a NanoClaw project.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to this NanoClaw project
say_en.note: It will install dependencies and wire the startup call.

say_en.text: Set up the NanoClaw dashboard and run the build tests
Stream NanoClaw logs to a local dashboard for me
say_en.note: Adds the pusher and restarts the service.
